description_en: Imports a file from the temporary storage of Alibaba Cloud Model Studio into an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio data connection (formerly known as application data)
description_zh: 将存储于阿里云百炼临时存储空间内的文件导入至阿里云百炼数据连接（原应用数据）
kebab_example: aliyun bailian add-file --lease-id 68abd1dea7b6404d8f7d7b9f7fbd332d.17166xxxxxxxx --parser AUTO_SELECT --category-id cate_cdd11b1b79a74e8bbd675c356a91ee35xxxxxxxx --workspace-id llm-3shx2gu255oqxxxx --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFile

parameters.help_en: The upload lease ID, which corresponds to the `FileUploadLeaseId` returned by the ApplyFileUploadLease operation
parameters.help_zh: 上传租约 ID，对应 ApplyFileUploadLease 接口返回的` FileUploadLeaseId`
parameters.name: lease_id

parameters.help_en:
The parser type. Valid values:

DOCMIND: intelligent document parsing
DOCMIND_DIGITAL: electronic document parsing
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION: large language model document parsing
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER: Qwen VL parsing
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION_MEDIA: audio and video parsing
AUTO_SELECT: automatic parser selection

<props="intl">
<note>The uploaded file is parsed by using the currently specified parser. If you set this parameter to AUTO_SELECT, the parser configured for the category is used.</note>
</props>

<props="china">
<note>When CategoryType is set to UNSTRUCTURED, the parser parses the uploaded file based on the data parsing settings of the current category.</note>
<note>When CategoryType is set to SESSION_FILE, the system parses the file content by using the default method, which cannot be changed.</note>
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
解析器类型。可能取值范围包括：

DOCMIND（智能文档解析）
DOCMIND_DIGITAL（电子文档解析）
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION（大模型文档解析）
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER（Qwen VL 解析）
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION_MEDIA（音视频解析）
AUTO_SELECT（自动选择解析器）

<props="intl">
<note>会以当前设置的解析器对您上传的文件进行解析，若输入AUTO_SELECT则会使用所属类目配置的解析器。</note>
</props>

<props="china">
<note>当CategoryType为UNSTRUCTURED时，解析器会根据当前类目的数据解析设置，对您上传的文件进行解析。</note>
<note>当CategoryType为SESSION_FILE时，系统将使用默认方式（不支持更改）解析文件内容。</note>
</props>
parameters.name: parser

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

When CategoryType is set to UNSTRUCTURED, set this parameter to the category ID of the uploaded file, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also go to Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center), click the File tab, and then click the ID icon next to the category name to obtain the category ID. You can set this parameter to default to use the system-created default category.

When CategoryType is set to SESSION_FILE, set this parameter to "default".
</props>

<props="intl">

Set this parameter to the category ID of the uploaded file, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also go to Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center), click the File tab, and then click the ID icon next to the category name to obtain the category ID. You can set this parameter to default to use the system-created default category.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

当CategoryType为UNSTRUCTURED时，需传入上传文件所属类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`。您也可以前往应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取类目 ID。此处允许传入default，即使用系统创建的“默认类目”。

当CategoryType为SESSION_FILE时，传入“default”即可。
</props>

<props="intl">

需传入上传文件所属类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`。您也可以前往应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取类目 ID。此处允许传入default，即使用系统创建的“默认类目”。
</props>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. The file is uploaded to this workspace. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，即文件将上传至该业务空间中。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags associated with the file. You can specify up to 100 tags, and the total character length of all tags cannot exceed 700.
Default value: empty, which means no tags are set
parameters.help_zh:
文件关联的标签列表。最多传入100个标签，所有标签字符长度总和不能超过700。
默认值为空，即不设置标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The category type. This parameter is optional. Default value: UNSTRUCTURED. Valid values:
UNSTRUCTURED: category used for building knowledge base scenarios.

<props="china">
SESSION_FILE: file used for session interaction (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction) in agent applications.
<note>When using `SESSION_FILE`, set the CategoryType parameter to `SESSION_FILE` when calling the ApplyFileUploadLease operation as well.</note>
<note>The file is valid only for the current user session. After the user closes the session, the file expires. The maximum validity period is 7 days. Long-term storage is not supported.</note>
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
类目类型，可选，默认值为UNSTRUCTURED，取值范围：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目，用于构建知识库场景。

<props="china">
SESSION_FILE：用于智能体应用会话交互 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction)的文件。
<note>在使用 `SESSION_FILE` 的情况下，调用ApplyFileUploadLease接口时，CategoryType 参数也应传入 `SESSION_FILE`。</note>
<note>仅用户当前会话有效，用户关闭会话后文件过期（最长有效期为7天），不支持长期保存。</note>
</props>
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

Specifies a URL for the file. The system records this URL when building a https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html. When you use the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console to interact with an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842749.html, this URL is returned with the retrieval results of the file through the `docUrl` field.

The agent application must have Knowledge Base enabled and the Show answer sources feature turned on. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

</props>

<props="intl">

Specifies a URL for the file. The system records this URL when building a https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html. When you use the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console to interact with an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842749.html, this URL is returned with the retrieval results of the file through the `docUrl` field.

The agent application must have Knowledge Base enabled and the Show answer sources feature turned on. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

通过此参数为文件添加一个URL，系统将在构建https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html时记录该链接。在使用阿里云百炼控制台与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842749.html对话时，随该文件召回结果返回（通过0字段）。

智能体应用必须开启知识库，并启用展示回答来源功能，否则此参数不生效。

</props>

<props="intl">

通过此参数为文件添加一个URL，系统将在构建https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html时记录该链接。在使用阿里云百炼控制台与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842749.html对话时，随该文件召回结果返回（通过1字段）。

智能体应用必须开启知识库，并启用展示回答来源功能，否则此参数不生效。

</props>
